title: Rubric - Accuracy
evidence: All criteria accurately reflect the prompt's requirements: criterion 11 matches prompt's 'radial blast from the middle of the board that pushes every token outward'; criterion 12 matches 'fall under gravity, bounce off inner walls, collected once they cross the collection strip'; criterion 13 matches 'fires automatically on the repeating cycle'; criterion 14 matches 'board keeps itself populated so it never empties out'; criterion 16 matches 'Bomb.glb has to be rendered live as an actual 3D object...in its own viewport panel placed beside the board...dedicated 3D camera and at least two lights'; telemetry criteria match the exact MOTION_SAMPLE and ACTION_TRANSITION formats specified in the prompt. No criterion states something the prompt does not require or contradicts what it asks for.
